meaning:
γόμος, -ου, ὁ
(γέμω), [in LXX: Exo.23:5, 4Ki.5:17 (מַשָּׂא) * ;]
a ship's freight, cargo: Act.21:3, Rev.18:11, 12.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: When we had come in sight of Cyprus, leaving it on the left hand, we sailed to Syria and landed at Tyre, for the ship was there to unload her cargo.
The merchants of the earth weep and mourn over her, for no one buys their merchandise any more:
